topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 97 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 19 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (positionmanagerdependent, ownable2step, whitelist). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
